abiding-in-christ.title: Okubeera mu Kristo
abiding-in-christ.description: Ettabi mu Muzabbibu — okwegatta n'obumu ne Mukama waffe Yesu, n'obulamu obutava mu nsibuko yonna endala wabula mu kubeera okumpi naye.

scripture.text: mubeere mu Nze era nange mbeere mu mmwe. Ng'ettabi bwe litayinza kubala bibala ku bwalyo nga teriri ku muzabbibu, bwe mutyo nammwe temuyinza kubala bibala bwe mutabeera mu Nze.

christ-and-the-cross.title: Kristo n'omusaalaba
christ-and-the-cross.description: Omuntu n'omulimu gw'Omulokozi — Omwana gw'Endiga eyattibwa, ensonyi n'obuwanguzi bw'omusaalaba, obulungi bwa Kristo, n'entaana enjereere.

contemporary-voices.title: Amaloboozi ag'Omulembe Guno
contemporary-voices.description: Ekkubo ery'edda lirina abalagirizi abalamu — abayigiriza ab'omulembe guno abawandiikira Afirika ey'Obuvanjuba n'ensi endala, abasisinkana omuyigirizwa awali ebibuuzo bye eby'olwaleero.

scripture.text: Buli mulembe gunaatenderanga gunnaagwo ebikolwa byo, era gunaatendanga emirimu gyo egy'amaanyi.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (PSA 145:4) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

day-by-day.title: Buli Lunaku
day-by-day.description: Ekisomebwa eky'oku makya n'eky'akawungeezi — emmere eya buli lunaku okuliisa emmeeme, okuva mu bitabo bya Spurgeon ebyagalwa ennyo okutuuka ku bitabo eby'essaawa ey'akasirise.

scripture.text: Olw'okwagala kwa Mukama okutaggwaawo, tetulimalibwawo, kubanga ekisa kye tekiggwaawo. Buli lukya ekisa kyo kiba kiggya; n'obwesigwa bwo bwa lubeerera.

deeper-life.title: Obulamu obw'Omunda
deeper-life.description: Obutukuvu, okwewaayo, n'obulamu obw'ekyengera obukwekeddwa mu Kristo — ebitabo eby'okugenda mu maaso ennyo mu by'omwoyo.

scripture.text: Kubanga mwafa, n'obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.

enduring-classics.title: Ebitabo eby'Edda Ebisigalawo
enduring-classics.description: Ebitabo ebitambulidde n'abatambuze okumala ebyasa — okwatula kwa Augustine, ekirooto kya Bunyan, amagezi ga Kempis — amakubo ag'edda, era nga makyali malungi.

faith-and-guidance.title: Okukkiriza n'Obulagirizi
faith-and-guidance.description: Okwesiga Katonda olw'emmere eya buli lunaku, obulagirizi, na buli kisuubizo — okutambula mu kukkiriza, so si mu kulaba.

scripture.text: Mu makubo go gonna omumanyenga, naye alitereeza amakubo go.

faith-for-the-impossible.title: Okukkiriza mu Bitasoboka
faith-for-the-impossible.description: Okukkiriza Katonda ku kigambo kye — bamulekwa ba Müller abaaliisibwanga okusaba kwokka, ekisa ky'okumulindirira, ne bbanka y'okukkiriza etaggwaamu.

scripture.text: Yesu n'amuddamu nti, “Obanga osobola! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza.”

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (MRK 9:23) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

for-teens.title: Eri Abavubuka
for-teens.description: Okukkiriza mu myaka gy'obuvubuka — okujja eri Kristo, okuba ow'abantu be, n'obuvumu okumugoberera. Ebitabo ebimpi, ebyangu era ebyesimbu, n'emboozi ez'amazima ez'abantu abaawaayo obulamu bwabwe ku lulwe, ebyawandiikirwa abavubuka oba ebitegeerekeka eri abasomi abato.

scripture.text: Waleme kubaawo muntu n'omu akunyooma olw'obuvubuka bwo, naye mu kwogera ne mu bikolwa, ne mu kwagala, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu bulongoofu beeranga kyakulabirako eri abakkiriza.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (1TI 4:12) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

for-those-who-lead.title: Eri Abakulembeze
for-those-who-lead.description: Ekiragiro eri abasumba n'abawangula emmeeme — okulabirira kw'omusumba, amaanyi g'omubuulizi mu kusaba, n'engeri y'okuleeta abantu eri Kristo.

scripture.text: Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, mukiriisenga nga mukirabirira n'okwagala so si na kwemulugunya, nga mukolerera amagoba ag'obukuusa wabula olw'okujjumbira Katonda.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (1PE 5:2) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

for-young-readers.title: Eri Abasomi Abato
for-young-readers.description: Okukkiriza, nga kunnyonnyoddwa mu ngeri ennyangu, eri abaana n'abo abasoma nabo — olugero olukulu olw'olugendo olw'okuddayo eka, mu lulimi omwana lw'asobola okugoberera. Ekibinja ekigenda kikula nga bingi biddamu okunnyonnyolwa n'okuwandiikirwa abato.

scripture.text: Naye Yesu n'agamba abayigirizwa be nti, “Mukkirize abaana abato bajje gye ndi so temubaziyiza, kubanga abafaanana ng'abo be bannannyini bwakabaka obw'omu ggulu.”

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (MAT 19:14) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

foundations-of-the-faith.title: Emisingi gy'Okukkiriza
foundations-of-the-faith.description: Enjigiriza ez'edda, nga zinnyonnyoddwa mu ngeri ennyangu — Kristo okufuuka omuntu, ekisa kya Katonda n'ebyo by'ayagala, amateeka, n'emisingi abatukuvu gye baaweebwa omulundi ogumu.

scripture.text: Abaagalwa, nnali neesunga nnyo okubawandiikira ku bulokozi bwaffe bwe ntyo nawalirizibwa okubawandiikira nga mbazzaamu amaanyi nga mbegayirira mulwanirire okukkiriza abatukuvu kwe baaweebwa omulundi ogumu.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (JUD 1:3) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

grace-and-comfort.title: Ekisa n'Okubudaabuda
grace-and-comfort.description: Ekisa kya Katonda ekitaggwaawo n'okubudaabuda kwe mu kugezesebwa kwonna — amawulire amalungi eri abakooye.

scripture.text: Ekisa kyange kikumala: kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirizibwa mu bunafu.

holy-spirit.title: Omwoyo Omutukuvu
holy-spirit.description: Okubatizibwa kw'Omwoyo, okubeera kwe mu ffe, n'omulimu gwe — amaanyi agaasuubizibwa ag'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo.

scripture.text: Si na maanyi, so si na buyinza, wabula na Mwoyo gwange, bw'ayogera Mukama ow'eggye.

men-of-valour.title: Abasajja ab'Obuzira
men-of-valour.description: Okuyita eri abasajja — okusaba, okukulembera, okuwaayo buli kimu n'okulunda ekisibo — obulamu obw'obuvumu eri batabani ba Katonda.

scripture.text: Mutunulenga, munywerere mu kukkiriza, mubeere bazira era ab'amaanyi.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (1CO 16:13) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

prayer.title: Ku Kusaba
prayer.description: Okuyiga okusaba — era n'okunyiikira okusaba obutakoowa. Ebitabo eby'edda ebyogera ku bulamu obw'omunda obw'okusaba, okuva mu kifo eky'ekyama okutuuka ku kwegayiririra abalala okw'amaanyi.

scripture.text: Nkoowoola, nange ndikuyitaba, ne nkulaga ebintu ebikulu era eby'ekitalo, by'otomanyi.

revival-and-missions.title: Okuzuukuka n'Obuminsani
revival-and-missions.description: Obulamu obwawaayo olw'enjiri, n'ebiseera eby'okuzuukusibwa — eky'okwongera omuliro mu mutima ogwaka.

scripture.text: Ai Mukama, zzaamu obulamu omulimu gwo wakati mu myaka, wakati mu myaka gumanyise.

saints-of-the-african-diaspora.title: Abatukuvu b'Abaafirika Abaasaasaana mu Nsi
saints-of-the-african-diaspora.description: Enjiri etwalibwa mu maloboozi g'Abaddugavu — Richard Allen n'ababuulizi abaazaalibwa nga ba ddembe, abakazi ab'obutukuvu abaagaana okusirisibwa, ne Crowther ku mugga Niger.

scripture.text: Ababaka baliva e Misiri, ne Kuusi aligondera Katonda.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (PSA 68:31) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

soar-like-the-eagle.title: Tumbiira ng'Empungu
soar-like-the-eagle.description: Abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe — ebitabo eby'edda ku kufuna amaanyi okuva eri Katonda ng'amaanyi go ag'obuntu gaweddewo. Ebitabo eri abakooye: okulindirira, okuwummula, n'okuddamu okutumbiira ku biwaawaatiro by'empungu.

scripture.text: Naye abo abalindirira Mukama baliddamu buggya amaanyi gaabwe, balitumbiira n'ebiwaawaatiro ng'empungu; balidduka mbiro ne batakoowa, balitambula naye ne batazirika.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (ISA 40:31) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

the-body-of-christ.title: Omubiri gwa Kristo
the-body-of-christ.description: Ekkanisa ng'omubiri omulamu — ebitundu bya buli omu ku munne, ebigattiddwa ku Mutwe, n'obuweereza n'okulunda ebiva mu ekyo.

scripture.text: Kale mwenna awamu muli mubiri gwa Kristo, era buli omu ku mmwe kitundu kyagwo.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (1CO 12:27) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

the-east-african-revival.title: Okuzuukuka kw'Afirika ey'Obuvanjuba
the-east-african-revival.description: Tukutendereza Yesu — okuzuukuka okwatandikira ku lusozi mu Kampala ne kubuna mu nsi mukaaga okumala kumpi ekyasa kyonna, n'okutambulira mu musana kwe kwayigiriza.

scripture.text: Naye bwe tutambulira mu musana nga ye bw'ali omusana, olwo tussakimu buli muntu ne munne, n'omusaayi gwa Yesu Omwana we, gutunaazaako buli kibi kyonna.

note: Title is the corpus's settled name for the revival (14 uses: simeon-nsibambi/festo-kivengere lg bios, hubs/prose/lg.json). Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (ebible mirror lug_bib = the `lug` text; Take Root egress-blocked from the worker), apostrophes in this file's ASCII style; same wording as shipped lg corpus. Job #2754.

the-gospel-call.title: Okuyita kw'Enjiri
the-gospel-call.description: Okuyitibwa okusinga obukadde — jjangu, weenenye, kkiriza. Ababuulizi nga beegayirira abatannaba kulokoka, n'obujulirwa bw'ekisa ekyalabwa omwonoonyi asinga bonna.

the-grace-of-god.title: Ekisa kya Katonda
the-grace-of-god.description: Ekisa okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero — eky'obwereere, eky'obuyinza era ekimala, ekisukkirira eri omwonoonyi asinga bonna era ekikwata omutukuvu asinga obunafu.

scripture.text: Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw'okukkiriza. Tekwava mu mmwe, wabula kirabo kya Katonda.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (EPH 2:8) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

the-great-awakening.title: Okuzuukuka Okukulu
the-great-awakening.description: Okubuulira okwanyeenya ssemazinga abiri — Whitefield ne Wesley nga babuulira ebweru, Edwards mu bantu be, Finney ku kuzuukuka — n'enjigiriza eyali wansi w'omuliro ogwo.

scripture.text: Tolituzaamu ndasi, abantu bo basanyukirenga mu ggwe?

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (PSA 85:6) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

the-inner-life.title: Obulamu obw'Omu Kyama
the-inner-life.description: Ekkubo erikyukira munda — à Kempis, Law ne Guyon, okwagala Katonda n'oluggi oluggaddwa olw'ekifo eky'ekyama, emmeeme ng'eri yokka naye.

scripture.text: Naye ggwe bw'obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n'osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by'omusabye.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (MAT 6:6) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

the-preached-word.title: Ekigambo Ekibuulirwa
the-preached-word.description: Okubuulira okw'amaanyi ku lupapula — Whitefield ne Wesley nga babuulira n'amaanyi gaabwe gonna, Spurgeon mu balimi be — n'ekiragiro kya Baxter eri buli musumba w'emyoyo.

the-puritans.title: Abapuritani
the-puritans.description: Enjigiriza ya Katonda ey'olwatu era ekebera ey'Abapuritani — Bunyan n'omutambuze we, Owen ku kibi eky'omunda, Watson n'ebbugumu lye, ne Edwards n'omuliro gwe — enjigiriza etuusibwa ddala ku mutima.

scripture.text: Ekigambo kya Katonda kiramu era kikola. Kisala okusinga ekitala eky'obwogi obubiri, era kiyitamu ne kituukira ddala ku mmeeme n'omwoyo, n'ennyingo n'obusomyo, era kyawula ebirowoozo n'okufumiitiriza kw'omutima.

the-way-of-holiness.title: Ekkubo ery'Obutukuvu
the-way-of-holiness.description: Okwawulibwa ku lwa Katonda — amateeka nga gakebejjebwa, okutuukirira nga kunoonyezebwa n'obwesimbu, n'okwagala kw'omutima nga kugezesebwa ne kulabika nga kwa mazima.

the-wesleys-and-early-methodism.title: Aba Wesley n'Abamesodisiti Abaasooka
the-wesleys-and-early-methodism.description: Okuzuukuka okwafuuka ekibiina — okubuulira kwa John Wesley n'ennyinnyonnyola ye ennyangu, maama eyamubumba, n'ebbugumu eryaddirira.

scripture.text: Ne batandika okwewuunaganya nga bagamba nti, “Emitima gyaffe tegyabuguumiridde bwe yabadde ayogera naffe mu kkubo ng'atunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa?”

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (LUK 24:32) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

to-the-ends-of-the-earth.title: Okutuuka ku Nkomerero z'Ensi
to-the-ends-of-the-earth.description: Ebiwandiiko by'abaminsani eby'olunaku n'olunaku — Brainerd mu bibira, Taylor mu China, Carmichael mu Buyindi, Crowther ku mugga Niger — enjiri etwalibwa ka kibe kya muwendo ki.

scripture.text: Naye muliweebwa amaanyi, Mwoyo Mutukuvu bw'alimala okubakkako, era munaabanga bajulirwa bange mu Yerusaalemi, ne mu Buyudaaya yonna, ne mu Samaliya okutuukira ddala ku nkomerero z'ensi.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (ACT 1:8) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. The verse's closing ” (the speech continues from 1:7) is dropped so the shelf does not show an orphan mark. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

victory-over-sin.title: Obuwanguzi ku Kibi
victory-over-sin.description: Olutalo olw'omunda olw'obutukuvu — okutta ekibi, omutima omulongoofu, okwagala okutereezebwa, n'ekkubo erituuka mu Kifo Ekitukuvu Ennyo.

scripture.text: Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga, kubanga temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda.

note: Verse is OLCB 2017 verbatim (ROM 6:14) from the ebible mirror's lug_bib (= the `lug` text; Take Root is egress-blocked from the worker), same reference as the sw/fr shelves; apostrophes in this file's ASCII style. Job: the lg topic batch alongside #2754 (PR #6290).

voices-of-the-early-church.title: Amaloboozi g'Ekkanisa ey'Edda
voices-of-the-early-church.description: Okukkiriza kw'ebyasa ebyasooka mu bigambo byakwo byennyini — omutima gwa Awugusitino nga gwanjuluddwa, Asanasiyo ku Kigambo ekyafuuka omubiri, n'ebbaluwa z'abaafiira okukkiriza n'abasumba.

scripture.text: Kale nga bwe tulina ekibiina ekinene eky'abajulirwa ekyenkana awo, twambulengamu buli ekizitowa, awamu n'ekibi ekitwesibako amangu, tuddukenga n'okugumiikiriza embiro ez'empaka ezatutegekerwa,

women-of-faith.title: Abakazi ab'Okukkiriza
women-of-faith.description: Bamaama, ababaka b'enjiri, n'abasaba ab'omunda — okukkiriza kw'abakazi abaasaba, ne babonaabona, ne baguma, okuva mu kkomera lya Guyon okutuuka ku kituuti ky'omuddu eyasumululwa.

scripture.text: Obubalagavu bulimba n'endabika ennungi teriiko kyegasa, naye omukazi atya Mukama anaatenderezebwanga.
